text:
incident_bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Increased p99 serving latency observed in cluster-7 (region-us-west) over the last 5m. p95 up ~3x, p99 > 3s. Streaming stalls and client timeouts reported. Auto-escalation to oncall. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/d/serve/cluster-7?from=now-10m

morgan: Oncall here. pulling up traces and kpis. which customer traffic is hitting cluster-7? any throttles in place?

ashwin: I see a big spike in kv.cache.evictions.rate and slab_alloc.failures around 1769801100. Prefill miss rate jumped too -> more decode load. Looks like fragmentation on hot shards + prefill/decode imbalance. Screens: https://telemetry.redwood.ai/d/kv/cluster-7 and flame: https://traces.redwood.ai/trace/abc123

morgan: copying ashwin. initial customer impact? Sam, any support hits?

sam (support): seeing increased error reports for streaming clients from a handful of large customers 

- 3 customers reporting partial streams / reconnects in last 10m. CS ticket ids: R-6732, R-6733, R-6734. No data exposures.

toni: FYI, autoscaler didn't spin up more workers because memory pressure triggered eviction earlier. cache slab utilization at 94% on node-group-7a. eviction burst correlates with prefill queue backlog.

ashwin: root cause hypothesis: fragmentation + aggressive eviction while prefill inflight + decode threads trying to cold-load KV entries. Prefill vs decode imbalance causing tail stalls (decode waits on disk / page-in). p99 correlates with KV page faults.

ken (sre): good summary. Proposed live mitigations (low-risk first):
1) Temporarily reduce eviction aggressiveness to stop thrash
2) Throttle prefill inflight to reduce parallel cold loads
3) Route a fraction of traffic to fallback model variant (smaller KV footprint)
4) If stable, expand slab for hot shard group

morgan: do we have commands for (1) and (2)?

ashwin: yes 1 running these now (will post exact commands).

ashwin: Running:
```
# reduce eviction aggressiveness
rctl cluster-ops set cluster-7 cache.eviction_aggressiveness=0.6
# throttle prefill inflight
rctl cluster-ops set cluster-7 prefill.max_inflight=40
# route 10% to fallback model
rctl routing set cluster-7 traffic_split='{\"gpt-medium-v1\":0.9, \"gpt-small-v1\":0.1}'
```
Applying changes to cluster-7 in 2m. watching metrics.

morgan: acknowledged. tagging incident channel and paging ken. @ken can you watch slab allocs during rollout?

ken (sre): watching. initial readouts: eviction rate dropping after config push, prefill backlog down from 320 -> 80 in ~90s. p95 improving, p99 still noisy.

sam (support): customers R-6732/3/4 updated: we told them we are mitigating routing and asked for logs. they confirmed some reconnections but no data loss.

toni: small followups  while eviction reduced, I see a handful of nodes with high page-in IO wait (iowait) indicating disk-backed KV activity. we should avoid mass prefill to not spike iowait and cause more tail latency.

nashwin: agree. next step: disable prefill for the heaviest models temporarily and enable synchronous decode fallback (slower generation but avoids large prefill). Command:
```
rctl model set gpt-large-v2 prefill.enabled=false --cluster cluster-7
rctl model set gpt-large-v2 decode.fallback_sync=true --cluster cluster-7
```
Will do after traffic split completes.

morgan: going to update exec summary for handoff in 15m. current status: mitigations applied (eviction, prefill throttle, routing). p95 back to within SLO for most routes. p99 still ~1.8x SLO for some taily streams. no new customer-impacting errors reported since mitigation.

nashwin: applying slab increase to hot shard group (canary nodes)  small roll: `rctl cluster-ops adjust-slab cluster-7 --shard hot-01 --delta +8%` watching memory. If stable, will roll to rest.

ken (sre): slab canary looks fine, mem pressure resolved on canary nodes. p99 dropping slowly. Prepare to revert some temporary routing after 30m if stable.

morgan: timestamped handoff planned at 1769801400 -> assigning to elaine for overnight follow-up and postmortem. quick summary for handoff:
- Incident: KV cache fragmentation + eviction burst -> prefill/decode imbalance -> streaming tail stalls, p99 breaches
- Actions taken: reduced eviction aggressiveness, throttled prefill inflight, 10% traffic routed to smaller model, disabled prefill on largest model, canary slab increase on hot shard
- Impact: 3 customers had reconnections, no data loss. p95 back in SLO, p99 improving but not fully recovered at handoff time.

elaine: taking over. thanks Morgan + team. I will hold for 1h to observe, then open postmortem ticket and schedule follow-up with Storage/Runtime/ML owners. leaving notes in incident board.

morgan: thanks, handoff complete. please escalate to infra if p99 creeps again.

elaine: ack. creating postmortem placeholder: PM-2179. will add timeline, config diffs, and recommended long-term mitigations (better slab compaction, smarter prefill backpressure, route-aware prefill limits, and tighter telemetry for prefill vs decode latency correlation).

incident_bot: Incident marked as mitigated for customer-impacting errors at 1769801548. Continue monitoring for 1h.

elaine: closing thread in channel and moving details to /incidents/postmortems/PM-2179.
